narrative.intro: Ram System Gmbh has $487M in federal contract obligations for FY2026 to date. Ram System Gmbh won 8 awards so far in the fiscal year, with an average award size of $60.9M and obligations up 10.5% year over year. Guided Missile and Space Vehicle Manufacturing is the largest reported market for Ram System Gmbh, accounting for $487M in FY2026 to date. Historical obligations for Ram System Gmbh show fluctuation across recent years: FY21 obligations were $136M, FY22 obligations were $6M, FY23 obligations were $680M, FY24 obligations were $11.9M, and FY25 obligations were $441M. The current-year totals are partial and reflect fiscal year to date figures. The award counts and values reflect obligations rather than total contract sizes except where award-value tables are explicitly noted otherwise. This profile highlights the concentration of Ram System Gmbh’s reported federal work in a single NAICS and the company’s multi-year pattern of obligations when comparing FY2026 to prior years.
